children: Prelude Therapeutics received FDA clearance to proceed with a Phase 1 study of oral KAT6A degrader PRT13722 and expects patient enrollment in 4Q 2026.
FDA cleared Prelude to proceed with an IND for PRT13722, a first-in-class oral KAT6A selective degrader.
Prelude expects Phase 1 enrollment for HR+/HER2- breast cancer to begin in the fourth quarter of 2026.
Phase 1 will evaluate safety, tolerability, PK/PD and antitumor activity as monotherapy and in combinations.
Preclinical data show >1,000x selectivity for KAT6A, potent activity, tumor regressions and favorable bone-marrow safety signals.
Investor presentation and press release furnished as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2; materials not deemed filed under Exchange Act Section 18.
